_source: Shape of a replica-data Orphan (an orphaned replica directory on a disk) as Longhorn v1.13.0 creates it, built from Longhorn's own code at tag v1.13.0:

https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn-manager/blob/v1.13.0/k8s/pkg/apis/longhorn/v1beta2/orphan.go (OrphanTypeReplicaData = "replica" - the orphanType VALUE is "replica", not "replica-data"; parameter keys OrphanDataName = "DataName", OrphanDiskName = "DiskName", OrphanDiskUUID = "DiskUUID", OrphanDiskPath = "DiskPath", OrphanDiskType = "DiskType"; DataCleanable condition)

https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn-manager/blob/v1.13.0/controller/node_controller.go (NodeController.createOrphan: NodeID = node.Name, Type = OrphanTypeReplicaData, Parameters DataName = the replica directory, DiskName, DiskUUID, DiskPath, DiskType)
https://github.com/longhorn/longhorn-manager/blob/v1.13.0/controller/orphan_controller.go (deleting a replica-data orphan deletes the replica directory named by DataName on that disk)
Names, uids and timestamps are placeholders.
